verdict.rationale: The evidence documents conversation checkpointing to save and resume sessions, but nothing shows those sessions can be continued from another device or a browser. Cloud Shell availability is a host-platform feature, and @gemini-cli mentions in GitHub are a separate delegation feature; neither is cross-device task continuity. Local resume is adjacent to the story, not the cross-device handoff it asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser
